root_cause_evidence: Earlier q95 12x109 L-BFGS-B optimization bound the active support ceiling and produced predicted improvements outside the cached Step2 query range; exact SWMM replay exposed false-beneficial optimized plans.
V11 exact target-latch replay remained only 11/15 sign-correct and stronger events contained false-beneficial first moves despite clean engineering execution.

V12 accepted local target-latched H360 replay was sign-correct on 9/9 sampled decisions with zero false-beneficial, yet event-level Proposed TFV beat No-control on only 1/3 Development probes and Auto-RBC on 0/3.

The previous policy-return critic label described one H10 intervention followed by a frozen continuation, but its model input repeated the candidate target through H360; this silently retained the open-loop action representation.
The previous V14 portfolio still called the full V12 L-BFGS-B optimizer before ranking alternatives, so the known high-dimensional optimizer remained the online proposal bottleneck.
current_response: Freeze Step1 and base Step2 V5; do not retrain the expensive representation solely because the deployed estimand changed.
Use base Step2 in batched inference only to score finite support-bounded +/- H10 single-actuator probes across all 109 facilities.
Combine the strongest individually predicted-beneficial probe directions within q95 changed-facility support and offer full/half learned directions plus one type-aware hydraulic-pressure direction.
Encode every policy-return model query as H10 candidate followed by H350 HOLD, matching the exact paired SWMM intervention.
Rank and admit the small same-prefix portfolio with the receding-policy-return critic and rainfall-group one-sided conformal upper bound; execute HOLD if no upper bound is negative.
Keep the historical V12 L-BFGS-B policy only as the frozen offline pi0 continuation used to create the first role-disjoint paired labels; it is not the Practical online optimizer.
If pi1 materially changes behavior, collect a new role-disjoint Q^pi1 round before any Policy Lock.

hard_rules: sole online optimization objective is system-wide cumulative TFV
Priority8 PFV is an authoritative secondary non-inferiority safety condition: proposed <= 100 m3 + 1.05 * no_control unless a later preregistered contract changes it
all 109 writable facilities are screened through finite H10 probes; no preselected small actuator subset is assumed
actuator bounds, 0.5 target slew, q95 first-move density support and q95 joint sequence support remain canonical
HOLD means latch the previous supervisory target
unchanged facilities retain previous commanded targets exactly
score equals execute; no material post-score projection is allowed
policy-return action encoding is H10 candidate then H350 HOLD; persistent H360 candidate encoding is forbidden
candidate and HOLD authoritative branches share the same raw causal prefix and same frozen continuation policy after H10
future realised rainfall, future SWMM state/flooding, future Internal trajectory and online SWMM candidate search are forbidden
policy-return train, model-selection validation and conformal calibration rainfall groups are disjoint
base Step2 and policy-return selection are evaluated by action utility metrics including false-beneficial rate, same-query ranking and selected regret, not scalar MAE alone
Auto-RBC and EFD use actuator-type-aware hydraulic release-to-SETTING semantics and are never weakened or used as Proposed warm starts
all-max-setting and all-min-setting remain diagnostic extremes, not operational comparators the Proposed method must universally beat
no Validation/Final/Formal/Policy Lock data may calibrate or tune the policy
production and untouched evaluation remain fail-closed
development_sequence: synchronize only from GitHub main after this refactor is merged and run full pytest/lint/help gates before expensive work
auto-discover and freeze one absolute-path Practical asset manifest from existing study_v069 artifacts; never silently fall back to historical path guesses
reuse frozen graph, sensors, Step1, base Step2 V5, q95 support and compatible Development assets; do not regenerate generic D3 or retrain base Step2 without evidence
run one seen T30 decision-3 exact-prefix engineering smoke and build the new H10 probe portfolio without L-BFGS-B
run authoritative same-prefix SWMM truth for every distinct candidate in that one query and verify at least the mechanism is identifiable before bulk generation
preregister role-disjoint rainfall groups for policy-return train >=48, model-selection validation >=12, conformal calibration >=24 and separate new Development probes
for each selected prefix generate exact candidate/HOLD labels using a frozen parent continuation; reuse one HOLD truth inside a same-query candidate set whenever identity is proven
compile same-query datasets and fine-tune only Step2 control/action heads by default
select the critic by false-beneficial selection, same-query ranking, selected regret and then MAE; score untouched calibration contexts and derive one-sided rainfall-group admission
define pi1 with H10 probe/hydraulic proposals plus the calibrated policy-return critic and run new Development closed-loop probes against unchanged baselines
compute authoritative TFV, Priority8 PFV safety and report-only Global Peak from node statistics
if pi1 materially differs from pi0, collect a new role-disjoint Q^pi1 round; only stable, technically clean Development evidence may proceed to Policy Lock
